title: CryptoFunds
tagline:
Our application is a donation application where users can donate cryptocurrency to their
favourite content creators.
description: Now-a-days content creators are not receiving enough amount of fame and money irrespestive of what value they provide to the society like education, entertainment, etc..CryptoFunds will be a solution for this problem. Using CryptoFunds we will be able to donate cryptocurrencies to our favourite content creators.
how_its_made: Faced some issues deploying the contract in testnetwork and we used ganache for overcoming this issue
